purpose: Acceptance contract for the GPG-001 trust-foundation slice of the global PR/API review gate.
sourceRequest: Implement the approved central GitHub App/broker algorithm while preserving exact-candidate, independent-review, fail-closed, and secret-isolation guarantees.

criteria.criterion: Broker policy and runtime evidence use closed schemas that bind repository, PR, head SHA, base SHA, App installation, candidate, prompt, verdict, settlement, provenance, and external check identity.
criteria.evidence: Policy/runtime schemas and mutation tests reject missing, additional, mismatched, stale, and caller-substituted fields.

criteria.criterion: Webhook input is streaming-bounded, signature-verified over exact bytes, action-bound, and replay-protected by delivery, body, and provenance nonce.
criteria.source: Approved central GitHub App/broker and fail-closed requirements.
criteria.evidence: Positive and negative primitive tests cover size, signature, event/action, duplicate-body, conflicting-delivery, and nonce cases.

criteria.criterion: Maker provenance is Ed25519-verified against an authorized repository/key record and routes Sol makers to Terra while routing Terra, Claude, and Gemini makers to Sol; unknown or same-family invalid routes fail closed.
criteria.evidence: Generated-key contract tests cover valid signatures, authorization mismatches, replay, and every mandatory reviewer route.

criteria.criterion: Budget cost is derived only from primary provider token usage and frozen integer-microusd pricing; overspend, uncertain usage, exhausted budget, and caller-supplied cost cannot produce a successful receipt.
criteria.evidence: Budget mutation tests cover reservation, exact settlement, rejection of totalTokens/caller cost, overspend accounting, uncertain charges, and monthly exhaustion.

criteria.criterion: A successful broker review can be persisted only when the exact candidate, sanitized diff/redaction manifest, prompt, verdict, settlement, reviewer route, provenance, external ID, and App check cross-bind.
criteria.source: Approved evidence and stale-PASS invalidation requirements.
criteria.evidence: Closed runtime-record tests accept one exact record and reject each independently altered binding.

criteria.criterion: GitHub App authentication uses the configured client-id issuer, bounded JWT lifetime, live installation equality, and repository-scoped installation tokens.
criteria.source: Approved central GitHub App security boundary.
criteria.evidence: Authentication tests inspect JWT claims, installation lookup, requested repository scope, and installation mismatch failure.

doneRule: This contract accepts only the GPG-001 trust-foundation staged slice through a high-risk exact-candidate Verification Loop. It does not complete the global control plane, deploy the GitHub App, enable a ruleset, publish a release, or mark GPG-001 verified.
